channel.title: Helium incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Helium's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Decrease in Hotspot Heartbeats [resolved]
item.description: We've resolved an issue affecting network connectivity, caused by a certificate issue. The certificate has been corrected, and we've implemented additional monitoring to detect and prevent this type of issue going forward.

item.title: Helium Mobile Hotspot Connection Issue [resolved]
item.description:
Some Helium Mobile Hotspots had an issue where devices could connect to WiFi but couldn’t actually use the internet, due to a problem on those specific units, while the overall network was working normally.
A fix is being worked on for affected hotspots - if you experience this behaviour, restarting your hotspot is advised.

item.title: IMS-Prod Upgrade Service Interruption [resolved]
item.description: During the IMS-Prod upgrade, services experienced a brief outage of roughly 15–20 minutes due to a load balancer and DNS issue introduced during the update. This impacted the Hotspot dashboard and related IMS services. The issue was identified and resolved, and all systems are now fully operational.

item.title: Carrier Traffic Degradation [resolved]
item.description: The technical issue impacting service has been resolved. Carrier traffic has stabilized. We’ll continue monitoring to ensure everything remains nominal.

item.title: Helium Wallet Native Swap Outage [resolved]
item.description:
Native swap functionality has been restored with the release of Helium Wallet v2.14.17, now live on both the App Store (iOS) and Google Play (Android).
Please update to the latest version to resume in-app swaps.

item.title: Investigating: Error 522 [resolved]
item.description: Resolved: Error 522 (Connection Timeout) We’ll continue monitoring to ensure stability. Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this.
